scope: Auxiliary radial envelope comparison of complete saved tool surfaces and saved H05 poses, with unselected axial registration

comparison_translation_m.meaning: Hypothetical location d of the entire saved tool CAD's leading end; d=-header Y. Not a bit protrusion, TCP or actual fastening pose.

tool_radius: Maximum perpendicular distance from the source CAD axis over every triangle clipped to a complete axial bin, regardless of azimuth
hand_radius: Previously observed minimum perpendicular distance from the nominal screw axis over every H05 triangle clipped to the corresponding bin
difference: Hand minimum radius minus tool maximum radius. Neither a 3D minimum distance nor a penetration depth; overlapping radial bounds do not prove surface intersection.
tool_state: Exactly the saved manufacturer example; no bit, nose, jaws, hose or stroke geometry is added or actuated
excluded: neighboring parts, other hands and product wiring
unmodeled feed hoses, moving nose states and the actual selected fastener/bit assembly
solid containment, continuous motion, compliance, gripping forces and fastening quality
